acceptanceCriteria: The DCP-V1-216 equivalence tests take budget and prefetch hooks per call (context-carried), not from package globals
They run under t.Parallel with -race clean
Package wall time measured before/after on the same host with load recorded
body: Lane test-speed-1021i (PR #1461, V1-2166) made 164 of 188 doccorpus tests parallel (408.9 s serial -> 114.1 s). The four DCP-V1-216 bulk equivalence tests do per-path Git reads and share package-level budget/prefetch state, so they stay serial: 217.6 s, 111.0 s, 103.3 s and an unmeasured Playwright one. They need per-call (context-carried) budget and prefetch hooks before t.Parallel is safe.
